messages:
carla: hey team — hitting flaky failure when resuming eval-harness with --resume-checkpoint. local run exits 1 but no error printed :confused:
carla: repro: `./eval-runner --config configs/qa.json --resume checkpoint/2026-03-10/ckpt.pt`
carla: tail of the log:
```
INFO Loading checkpoint ...
ERROR Failed to load cached state
FATAL Exiting with code 1
```
carla: would expect error message pointing to mismatch in schema or missing keys

alex: saw this before — exit code 1 is generic from our argparsing wrapper. Need exit codes for validation vs runtime crash.
alex: can we get `--dry-run` to validate config + checkpoint without running? that would help CI.

ben: assigning to me. looks like config validator returns non-zero but swallows details. I'll add logging in validator to print path + missing fields. quick question: is it only with quant experiments? any model?

carla: happens for quantized bert-lr-4bit and also unquantized gpt-mini. seems tied to checkpoint metadata.

eval-bot: note: CI: eval-harness/runner:flake on rust-integ (build 456) — linked failure 1876509990. Re-ran job, same exit 1.

lina: Suggest mapping exit codes:
- 2 = config validation error
- 3 = checkpoint mismatch / version error
- 4 = runtime OOM
Also improve CLI UX: `--validate-only` prints JSON schema errors and non-zero only for validation issues.

alex: agree. also add machine-friendly `--json-errors` so CI can assert message.

ben: putting up PR with:
- better exception handling in loader
- explicit exit codes
- `--validate-only` flag that returns 0 if schema OK even if checkpoint missing (optionally warn)
I'll ping when draft ready.

carla: thanks. small nit: add suggestion text to error like "run eval-runner --validate-only --config X" so onboarding is friendlier.

devx-sig: please include changelog entry for CLI behavior and doc update in docs/devex/quickstart.md

ben: FYI created draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/827
ben: tests added: unit for validator, integration for resume flow. need a quick review from @alex @lina

alex: reviewing today. :eyes:

lina: I'll add CI assertion for exit codes in the release pipeline.

carla: awesome, will rerun with new binary once merged. thanks all :rocket:
